carry_forward_constraints: S33 must consume only a promoted S32 feature-set manifest whose catalog/schema, complete fitted transformer state, hashes and expected feature_set_id are machine-validated; an fs-vN string alone is not a contract.

Fit every preprocessing step inside the training fold. Cross-validation or holdout evaluation must never fit imputers/scalers/vocabularies on validation/test data; use a real Pipeline/ColumnTransformer or an equivalent single fitted object.

S33 must not treat S30/S31 clusters or S32 graph features as truth unless each relational feature was derived from a versioned as-of graph view with typed identities, exact edge/evidence provenance and upstream cannot-link/decision gates resolved.
Missing contact/address remains non-evidence. In particular, do not accept S32 shared_address=1 when both values are absent; relational features need explicit observed/missing states.

Define target, prediction time and horizon before selecting S32 features. Every feature must have availability/knowledge time <= prediction cutoff; event time alone is insufficient for late-arriving sources.

Temporal counts/frequencies used by S33 must be replay-safe, computed from immutable event identities and point-in-time eligible data; late backfills must not rewrite historical training features silently.

Degree, unique-neighbor count, path existence/path length and other graph features are separate definitions and must retain graph-view parameters. Never inherit S31 adjacency-set degree or S32 bare-99 missing-path conventions.

S33 split/evaluation must use parsed timezone-aware chronology and the declared group policy, with non-empty train/validation/test support and zero forbidden group overlap. Keep 'split contamination' distinct from feature/target leakage.

Do not rely on feature-name substrings to prove absence of target leakage. Use catalog role/source/derivation/availability metadata and explicitly blacklist post-outcome/decision artifacts after the target/horizon is framed.
Before model comparison, run exact same-input train-versus-serve feature parity. Mean-only drift/skew alerts are monitoring signals, not proof that train and serve transformations are identical.
S33 must refuse to train/promote if S32's semantic leakage, parity, split or feature-manifest gates are not actually green; diagnostic prints do not satisfy a prerequisite.

If S33 persists sklearn pipelines/models with pickle/joblib, load only trusted artifacts and pin/record compatible Python, sklearn and dependency versions plus immutable training/feature-set references.

Keep pytest systematic: invalid catalog, NaN/missing, zero-variance scaling, all-missing categorical train, timezone-order split, empty holdout, future/late events, replay and target-leak features must remain regression tests.
Structural relational features remain signals, never fraud/culpability labels. S33 target framing must preserve the ER→relationship evidence→case triage separation.
Keep inherited Level-2 and S29-S32 regression debt active until upstream gates genuinely pass; a model cannot compensate for contaminated inputs.
